description:
What you grow, watch for, or saw on a plot — a page at a time.

`as_of` is how a past season answers: the record as it stood that day,
rather than as it stands now.

Sorting and searching happen in the database, over as many rows as the
block holds rather than the page you are looking at.

as_of.description: Read the record as it STOOD on this date (YYYY-MM-DD) — what was live then, including anything you have retired since.

block.description: The ground to read — its id, its name, or an alias.

kind.description: One of: planting, pest, wildlife, observation, seed.

npub.description: Required. Your Nostr public key (npub1...) for credit billing.

search.description: Case-insensitive regex over the name and the event, e.g. 'migration' finds both of a bird's. Empty matches everything.

season.description: Limit to one season year. Ignored for observations and seed lots.

since.description: Only observations on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

sort_col.description: Order by one of: name, event, driver, starts_on, target_gdd, observed_on, season, created, updated. Omit for the default order — sightings newest first, everything else by when it was added.

until.description: Only observations on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
